preset.wg.title: WireGuard
preset.wg.description: Plain WG endpoint. Max speed; DPI spots WG easily. Not demux.
preset.wg_awg2.title: AmneziaWG 2
preset.wg_awg2.description: AWG2 junk (jc/jmin/jmax) + masquerade. Breaks naive WG signatures at overhead cost.
preset.wg_awg3.title: AmneziaWG 3
preset.wg_awg3.description: AWG3 timings/HP/CPA + AWG2. Strongest signature hardening in the WG family.
preset.wg_custom.title: WG / AWG constructor
preset.wg_custom.description: Catalog schema for PUT /v1/controlplane/wg: MTU, listen_port, up/down Mbps, optional jc/jmin/jmax overrides. Not installable via from-presets. AWG i1–i5 are not used by this stack.
param.wg.mtu.title: MTU
param.wg_awg2.mtu.title: MTU
param.wg_awg2.mtu.help.summary: WireGuard interface MTU; match path MTU and NAT expectations.
param.wg_awg3.mtu.title: MTU
param.wg_awg3.mtu.help.summary: WireGuard interface MTU; match path MTU and NAT expectations.
param.wg_custom.mtu.title: MTU
param.wg_custom.mtu.help.summary: WireGuard interface MTU on the hub endpoint (PUT /wg).
param.wg_custom.listen_port.title: Listen UDP
param.wg_custom.listen_port.help.summary: UDP hub listen port. Not the public demux :443.
param.wg_custom.up_mbps.title: Upload Mbps
param.wg_custom.up_mbps.help.summary: Optional hub-wide upload Mbps ceiling on the WG endpoint.
param.wg_custom.down_mbps.title: Download Mbps
param.wg_custom.down_mbps.help.summary: Optional hub-wide download Mbps ceiling on the WG endpoint.
param.wg_custom.jc.title: AWG jc
param.wg_custom.jc.help.summary: Override AWG junk packet count after profile generate. Empty keeps generated value.
param.wg_custom.jmin.title: AWG jmin
param.wg_custom.jmin.help.summary: AWG jmin: lower junk packet size bound for AmneziaWG.
param.wg_custom.jmax.title: AWG jmax
param.wg_custom.jmax.help.summary: AWG jmax: upper junk packet size; must be >= jmin.
